title: VGFM: Expressive Robot Policies via Dense Value Guidance in Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.14261v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent robot learning paradigms increasingly rely on large offline datasets of robotic interactions to train control policies. Expressive generative models enable rich and multimodal action representations, expanding the capability of this paradigm for complex robotic control. However, policy improvement with multi-step generative actors remains challenging. In offline reinforcement learning (RL), incorporating value-based objectives along generative trajectories often introduces substantial training complexity, including backpropagation through time (BPTT), auxiliary architectures, or distillation losses. We propose Value-Guided Flow Matching (VGFM), a scalable offline RL framework that enables dense value-guided shaping within a flow-based policy while avoiding BPTT and additional algorithmic overhead. translated_abstract: 近期的机器人学习范式越来越依赖于大规模的机器人交互离线数据集来训练控制策略。富有表现力的生成模型能够实现丰富且多模态的动作表示，扩展了该范式在复杂机器人控制方面的能力。然而，使用多步生成式执行器进行策略改进仍然具有挑战性。在离线强化学习（RL）中，沿着生成轨迹引入基于价值的目标通常会带来大量的训练复杂性，包括时间反向传播（BPTT）、辅助架构或蒸馏损失。我们提出了价值引导流匹配（VGFM），这是一个可扩展的离线强化学习框架，能够在基于流的策略中实现密集的价值引导塑形，同时避免了BPTT和额外的算法开销。VGFM将策略参数化为动作（x-预测）空间中的条件流匹配模型，确保每个中间流……（摘要内容不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了价值引导流匹配（VGFM），一种可扩展的离线强化学习框架，无需时间反向传播和额外算法开销即可在流匹配策略中实现密集的价值引导，从而训练出更具表现力的多模态机器人控制策略。
en_tdlr: VGFM is proposed as a scalable offline RL framework that enables dense value-guided shaping within flow-matching policies without BPTT or additional algorithmic overhead, yielding more expressive multimodal robot control policies.
